messages.subject: Annotate statement error ???
parts:
What am I doing wrong with my annotate statement (5th line) ? What simple fix can I do to allow an annotation on the graph ? 

ct7cr <-ggplot(ct7,aes(mpy, midDate, ymin=midDate-deltaTime, ymax=midDate+deltaTime, xmin=0, xmax=2.0)) 
ct7cr <-ct7cr + scale_y_date(breaks="1 years",labels=date_format("%y")) 
ct7cr <-ct7cr + geom_linerange(color='blue', size=0.75) + coord_flip() 
ct7cr <-ct7cr + geom_point(color='red', size=1.5) 
ct7cr <-ct7cr + annotate('text', x=as.Date('08','%y'), y=Inf, label='testing',vjust=1.5, size=6) 
ct7cr <-ct7cr + theme(axis.title.x=element_blank()) 
ct7cr 

I keep getting the following error: "Error: Invalid input: date_trans works with objects of class Date only". Note that everything works without the annotate statement.

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Annotate statement error ???
parts:
I can't see what you're trying to accomplish without a reproducible
example, but if the idea is to place the annotation at the year
labeled '08' in your formatted scale_x_date() call, you need to use
the numeric equivalent of that date as the x; for example,

u <- as.Date("2011-08-01")
as.numeric(u) # number of days since the time origin

The default time origin is Jan. 1, 1970.

I'm not sure that setting y = Inf is the right thing to do in your
annotate() call, either; at the very least, I'd expect the label to be
at least partially cut off at the top, but it's hard to tell without
an example...

Dennis

messages.subject: Re: Annotate statement error ???
parts:
Hi:

Is this what you wanted?

ct7 <- read.table("ct7.txt", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
ct7 <- within(ct7, {
instDay <- as.Date(instDay)
remDay <- as.Date(remDay)
midDate <- as.Date(midDate)
} )

library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
ct7cr <- ggplot(ct7, aes(x = mpy, y = midDate)) +
scale_y_date(breaks="1 years", labels=date_format("%y")) +
geom_linerange(aes(ymin = midDate - deltaTime,
ymax=midDate + deltaTime,
xmin=0, xmax=2.0),
color='blue', size=0.75) +
geom_point(color='red', size=1.5) +
annotate('text', x = Inf, y = as.Date('2008-01-01'),
label='testing', vjust=1.5, size=6) +
coord_flip() +
theme(axis.title.x=element_blank())

You don't need to set a format for the date in annotate(); that's
taken care of by the scale_y_date() function.

Dennis
